final_response.answer: Virginia Tech’s AI courses focus on theory, search, reasoning and knowledge representation, while the ML offerings emphasize statistical modeling, data‑driven algorithms and practical implementation with tools like TensorFlow and PyTorch. AI classes tend to be more conceptual and interdisciplinary, whereas ML classes are usually more hands‑on with coding projects and data sets. Both tracks share core CS fundamentals but diverge in emphasis: AI on intelligent behavior design, ML on learning from data.
